system.description:
Shadesmen are the descendants of Shades - powerful shadow demons that once stalked the dark shadows of the world, hunting victims from their own shadows. Shadesmen are at home in the dark, and have the appearance of a dark, shadowy figure, obscured physically in black smoke or shadow.

Size: Medium (6–7 feet) · Lifespan: 60–80 years

Abilities: @UUID[Compendium.sacadia.heritages.Item.a7f6cf6be2c1bf0f]{Shadowstep}

Daemonai Heritage. Rulebook p.86.
